name: Endless Dream
detailed_description:
— BACKGROUND STORY —

In the future city, for unknown reasons, a supernatural energy entity named 'Yan Luo', with only the consciousness of killing, emerged.

The "Yan Luo" rapidly split and contaminated all living things, including artificial machinery.

After going through a hellish period of chaos and a confrontation that cost half of the world's population, humanity finally mastered the method to hunt down the "Yan Luo" and gradually gained the upper hand.

The dying ecosystem awaits reconstruction. Beneath the slightly eased situation, there lurks a turbulent undercurrent.

What changes will this world undergo because of your participation?

— ROMANCEABLE CHARACTERS —

❖LINGSHIQI❖

  • A younger brother figure who crossed paths with you while pursuing the same mission target. Though posing as your rival, he's been secretly watching over you all along—those "accidental" encounters? Calculated. Every clash of blades hides echoes of an unfinished destiny between you two.

❖WEISHANG❖   

  • Your devoted guardian and secret admirer—the embodiment of compassion to all, yet harbors a dangerous obsession reserved only for you. That serene smile? A carefully crafted mask. Every gentle touch leaves invisible chains, each whispered endearment laced with possessive venom.

❖YANJINGMING❖

  • The chosen one who looks down upon mere mortals—banks as his playground, divine favor as his birthright. Yet when his jewel-encrusted fingers reach for you, it's not the world he craves... but the way your laughter. That $20M diamond collar around your neck? Just Tuesday's impulse buy.

—GAME FEATURES—

Over 10 hours of mid-length story — Enjoy a complete romantic experience

Touching Company - With L2D Technology, He Feels Even More Real in the Palm of Your Hand

Explore the Sweetness - High Freedom Exploration Mode, Discover His Other Side

Mystery and micro-horror - an adrenaline-pumping adventure awaits your experience.

Multiple endings - multiple choices and branches. What awaits your future is...

short_description: This is a post-apocalyptic mystery exploration romance visual novel. you will embark on a romantic and thrilling journey with three significant characters to uncover the mystery of your past. Every decision you make will determine the ultimate fate of those you love and the world itself.
